claims.text: Cisco FY2024 total revenue was $53,803 million vs FY2023 $56,998 million, a decrease.

citations.quotation: Years Ended | July 27, 2024 | July 29, 2023 ... Total revenue | 53,803 |  | 56,998

counterarguments.text: Services revenue actually increased year-over-year (13,856 to 14,550), so the total decline is driven by the product line.

limitations: The excerpt provides revenue figures but does not include management's discussion of the reasons for the revenue decline, so no explanatory quotation about the change is available from this excerpt.
The table header declares units as 'in millions, except per-share amounts'; period end dates (July 27, 2024; July 29, 2023) are declared in the table but not independently verified.
Excerpts are not the whole source; other sections of the 10-K may discuss revenue change drivers.
